question.stem: Which of the following findings would be consistent with a diagnosis of cirrhosis?
question.footnote: © NCSBN. Taken from https://www.nclex.com/prepare.page; click on 'Download Exam Preview'.
question.preamble: The nurse is assessing a client with cirrhosis.
question.explanation: Spontaneous bruising is a classic cirrhosis finding, resulting from decreased synthesis of clotting factors by the diseased liver. Steatorrhea (Option 1) is more characteristic of pancreatic insufficiency or malabsorption. DVT (Option 2) is not a hallmark cirrhosis finding. High fever (Option 3) is not a defining feature of cirrhosis itself, though it can occur with a complication such as spontaneous bacterial peritonitis.
